title: Provider test options are accepted but silently ignored
reasoning: The shared render helper exposes initialAuth, initialLanguage, and routerInitialEntries as supported options, but initialAuth only swaps AuthProvider for a fragment without providing the requested auth state, initialLanguage is never passed to LanguageProvider, and routerInitialEntries is destructured but never used to create or provide a router. Tests that pass these options will run under different state than requested, which can either hide auth/language/routing regressions or make route-dependent components fail with missing router context.
reproduction: Call renderWithProviders(<ComponentThatReadsAuthOrRouter />, { initialAuth: { user, token }, routerInitialEntries: ['/somewhere'] }). The component will not receive the provided auth state and no RouterProvider is installed.
recommendation: Either implement these options fully by providing test-capable Auth, Language, and Router providers, or remove the unsupported options so tests cannot assume state setup that does not happen.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests exercise the helper itself or assert that supplied provider options affect rendered context.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a focused test component that reads auth, language, and router location from context, render it with each option, and assert the observed values match the supplied values.
minimumFixScope: Update app/__tests__/utils/test-utils.tsx to honor or remove initialAuth, initialLanguage, and routerInitialEntries.
